stories.title: Ukraine SOF: deepest strike hits Arctic gas plants; Russia kills 7

facts.text: Ukraine’s Special Operations Forces say they hit Novy Urengoy and Purovsky gas plants in Yamal-Nenets — claimed deepest strike of the war, >3,000 km from the border.
Regional governor: drone debris sparked a fire at an industrial site in Novy Urengoy; he says no deaths/injuries and that the attack was otherwise repelled.
Kremlin Urals envoy Artem Zhoga: first-ever strike on the Arctic part of the region (per Al Jazeera).
Same window: Russian attacks kill 4 in Mykolaiv and 3 at a Sumy shopping centre (14+ wounded there, incl. children), Ukrainian officials say.

ABC: overnight Russia launched 149 drones (mix of Shahed/jet-powered + decoys); Ukraine says 128 downed; NATO aviation assets briefly raised readiness in Polish airspace as a preventive measure (~2 hours).

stories.whyItMatters: Extends Kyiv’s long-range campaign into Russia’s Arctic gas heartland while overnight Russian strikes again hit Ukrainian cities and briefly pull NATO Poland into a readiness scramble.

image.alt: Russian attacks kill 7 in Ukraine as Kyiv targets gas plants deep in Arctic

stories.title: ENISA granted access to Anthropic Mythos 5 and OpenAI GPT-6-Astra

facts.text: European Commission spokesman (Thu): EU cybersecurity agency ENISA has been granted access to Anthropic’s Mythos 5 and is now testing it.
Same statement: ENISA was also granted access to OpenAI’s latest model, GPT-6-Astra.

stories.whyItMatters: Puts Europe’s cyber agency on frontier models just as labs face fresh scrutiny over agent/security incidents — useful for how EU regulators will actually probe these systems.

stories.title: Bundeswehr: 30 AI tools in evaluation; Palantir alternative aimed at 2027

facts.text: Handelsblatt: Bundeswehr is testing systems from 30 firms to fuse combat data in real time; story framed as introducing a Palantir alternative already in 2027.
One path highlighted: sensor firm Hensoldt with KI startup Helsing and their MDOCore stack (simulated Shahed-swarm demo).
Straits Times (Reuters): Vice Adm. Thomas Daum — prototype targeted for Q2 2027, full implementation 2028; most tools German; French ChapsVision among few foreign runners.
Straits Times: In April Daum ruled out buying Palantir’s Maven Smart System for now, citing dependence/data-sovereignty concerns even as US/NATO peers deploy it.

stories.whyItMatters: Berlin is trading speed for sovereignty on battlefield decision-support software — with a 2027 prototype timeline that still trails Maven’s existing deployments.

stories.title: Bitkom: German firms lean harder on US AI — ChatGPT 76%

facts.text: Bitkom (survey of 603 firms ≥20 employees, KW 28–33 2026; among AI users): ChatGPT 76% (was 70% prior year); Microsoft Copilot 35% (28%); Google Gemini 28% (22%).
Chinese apps barely register: DeepSeek 2%, Alibaba Qwen 1%. Llama 8%, SAP Joule 6%, Claude 3%; no surveyed firm reported Perplexity or European Mistral.
President Ralf Wintergerst: economy relies almost exclusively on US AI — digital sovereignty needs a chance for European providers; full KI-Einsatz study presentation Mon 14 Sep, 09:30.

stories.whyItMatters: Hard numbers behind the sovereignty talk: German corporate AI stack is still US-first even as Berlin funds defence/sovereign alternatives.
